verdict.rationale: ESD documents a paper rail for its core filing task: quarterly tax and wage reports can be filed by mail, paper forms are sent to new or paper filers or on request, and an amended-report PDF form can be submitted by email, mail or fax. However, none of the evidence gives the actual mailing addresses, fax numbers, or form numbers the story asks for. missing for 10: exact mailing addresses, fax numbers, specific form identifiers for the original quarterly report, an explicit outage-fallback statement, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a founder, a paper, fax, or mail fallback rail is published with the exact addresses, numbers, and forms, so the task can still be completed when the online flow is unavailable

citations.quote: You may file your quarterly tax and wage reports online or by mail.
Complete an amended tax and wage report form (PDF, 138KB). Submit it by email, mail or fax.
If you are a new employer or filed your last quarterly report on paper, we send you paper quarterly report forms.
